Senior Business Analyst and Technology Consultant with 4+ years of experience across global banking programmes at Citigroup
(CBNA UK, ASW, PCAT) and ANZ Bank. Skilled in end-to-end requirements gathering, business process analysis, stakeholder
management, and data-driven decision making. Experienced in Agile/Scrum environments with hands-on exposure to data analytics
tools including Tableau, Power BI, and SQL, and certified in Generative AI for Consultants. Strong foundation in BFSI with experties
in investment banking and capital markets, the ability to translate complex business problems into technology solutions across
domains. IIBA-endorsed Agile Analysis Certification (AAC). MBA in Finance.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst
Virtusa Consulting Services Pvt. Ltd. · Hyderabad
April 2022 – August 2026
Business Analyst and technology consultant across 3 programmes at 2 global banks — translating complex business requirements
into technology solutions, driving data-driven decision making, and delivering end-to-end change across regulatory, analytics, and
integration workstreams in Agile environments.
ANZ Bank — Deposit Management System
Business Analyst | Singapore & Hong Kong
January 2025 – August 2026
Liaised between ANZ business users and technology teams to define functional specs for SWIFT MT320 Inward & Outward
message flows — produced process maps, user stories, and acceptance criteria across Agile sprints.
Identified and communicated business impacts and risks of system changes — assessed field-level validation gaps and
multi-region transaction flow implications (SG, HK) prior to deployment, preventing production incidents.
Developed and executed 800+ integration test scripts — tracked defects and validated remediation through to release readiness
and go-live.
Citibank — Accounting Standardisation Workbench (ASW) / Controller Data Tool (CDT)
Business Analyst | Consent Order Analytics Platform | CBNA UK & Citigroup Global
January 2023 – July 2024
Led end-to-end requirements gathering for a consent order driven analytics platform — conducted stakeholder workshops across
Citigroup and CBNA UK, formulated system scope, and translated findings into detailed BRDs, functional specs, and data models.
Defined and operationalised a self-service analytics platform (CDT) enabling finance controllers to create use cases to bifurcate
and analyse balance sheet positions — replacing manual, error-prone Excel-based reporting across Citigroup globally.
• Managed data pipeline requirements across four source systems (SFTP, NAS, Couchbase, ISG Cloud) through a
Bronze-Silver-Gold medallion architecture — ensuring clean, standardised, and business-logic-ready data for Tableau dashboards.
• Built Tableau dashboards for KPI and governance reporting — balance sheet balances, heat maps, and percentage breakdowns
presented to senior Citi leadership.
Coordinated requirements and delivery alignment across 4–5 cross-functional stakeholder groups; developed 500+ UAT test
scripts, tracked defects, and supported go-live.
Citibank — PCAT Stability Team
Business Analyst | Risk Analysis & Process Improvement | Citigroup
April 2022 – December 2022
Analysed complex system stability issues — conducted in-depth evaluation of processes, systems, and industry standards;
identified root causes and recommended solutions to improve operational efficiency.
Maintained governance and RAID logs, tracked remediation progress, and escalated risks and control issues with full transparency;
prepared weekly status reports for senior Citi leadership.
KEY HIGHLIGHTS
Consent order delivery experience at Citigroup — built and delivered a regulatory analytics platform replacing manual balance
sheet reporting, directly addressing a US regulator directive across CBNA UK and Citigroup global teams.
1,300+ test scripts executed across programmes (800 ANZ integration + 500+ Citi UAT) — consistent end-to-end testing and
release delivery track record.
Data and analytics exposure — Tableau dashboard design, Bronze-Silver-Gold data pipeline requirements, KPI reporting, and
Power BI — bridging the gap between business requirements and data engineering teams.
GenAI certified — completed Virtusa's Gen AI Consultant certification programme in July 2026, demonstrating active upskilling in
emerging technology.
Agile-first practitioner — Scrum and Kanban across all programmes; IIBA-endorsed AAC validates formal methodology expertise.
Cross-domain adaptability — BFSI primary domain with strong analytical and consulting foundations transferable across industries
including healthcare, telecom, and government.
